_comment: PRESET: 3D-print files (STL). No credible public source publishes STL-specific Etsy price bands (searched 2026-11-23 — see docs/research-findings-2026-11-23.md, 'What could not be verified'), so the bands below are ESTIMATES anchored to the general digital-download bands and must be validated with the Stage 3 method before launch. Models must be your own originals (modelled e.g. in Blender, free/open source): since 2025-06-10 Etsy's Creativity Standards require computerised-tool items to be based on the seller's original design, and digital items must be made/designed by the seller.

affiliate_picks.category: 3D printers (the machines your files run on)
affiliate_picks.channel: Amazon Associates — print-log and review content
affiliate_picks.notes: Only printers you have actually used; Amazon rates for this category are low (~2.5-3%) — volume, not rate, is the play. Promoted off Etsy only (docs/affiliate-model.md).

affiliate_picks.category: Filament (PLA/PETG in the colours your models show)
affiliate_picks.notes: Name the exact filament in your test-print photos; buyers buy the look.

affiliate_picks.category: Printer tools, nozzles and build plates
affiliate_picks.notes: Consumables and upgrades your audience re-orders.

materials: Digital file: STL (ZIP for multi-part models) — no physical item ships

creation_path: Stage 3 research names the hobby/problem and cross-checks demand on eBay sold listings (Etsy publishes no STL sales data)
Write the model brief: the problem it solves or the niche it serves, dimensions, print constraints — your design, from a blank file
Model it in Blender (free, open source) and TEST-PRINT every model yourself; a model buyers can't print is a defect (Stage 4)
Export clean STL (ZIP for multi-part), <=20 MB per file, max 5 per listing; price with pipeline/pricing.py at zero cost (Stage 5)
Generate the listing pack with pipeline/listing.py (Stage 6): printer settings that worked, scale, licence terms; publish gate (Stage 7); test-download
delivery: Instant download of .stl files (an accepted Etsy upload format; ZIP for multi-part models) — buyers print at home. Optional second lane: sell physical prints of the SAME original models (see notes)
launch_checklist: Stage 1: intake answered — existing shop health-checked (Etsy Payments active, bank verified, shop policies set, production partners disclosed); no shop yet → appendix walkthrough first (docs/appendix-shop-creation.md)
Stage 2: SKIPPED for files (no Printify). Only relevant if you later print your own models to sell physically — then fulfilment is your own printer, not Printify
Stage 3: model ideas scored with pipeline/scoring.py; cross-check demand on eBay sold listings; confirm each model is YOUR original (June 2025 Creativity Standards)
Stage 4: model in Blender (or your tool); test-print every model yourself; fix failures before listing; export clean STL, ZIP multi-part sets; each file <=20 MB, max 5 per listing
Stage 5: price the file with the calculator at zero costs; if selling physical prints too, cost them separately at filament+power+wear+failures+time and price 3-5x

Stage 6: listing pack generated; description states INSTANT DOWNLOAD (file lane), printer settings that worked, scale, and licence terms (personal use unless you grant more); photos show YOUR test print, with a scale reference
Stage 7: human approves the exact files + pack; publish as a Digital listing; read the live listing back and test-download
Stage 8: watch print-failure questions and licence misuse reports; a model buyers can't print is a defect — fix the file, update the listing; weekly review as written
name: 3D-Print Files (STL)
niche: Original models for a specific hobby/problem (board-game inserts, replacement parts, desk/garden collectibles) — validated per-model with the Stage 3 method, eBay sold listings as a cross-check

pricing._comment: Digital sale of the file: zero production/shipping costs. Price shown is an ESTIMATE inside the unverified STL band — validate first.

products.name: Single original STL model
products.notes: ESTIMATE band — validate with Stage 3 before launch

products.name: Themed STL pack (3-5 models)
products.notes: ESTIMATE band — bundles carry digital margins, same as SVG

products.name: Board-game insert / organiser set (STL)
products.notes: ESTIMATE band — thin per-game competition, loyal buyers (tool-reported for physical; file demand untested)

products.name: Physical print of your own model (optional lane)
products.notes: Price at 3-5x your TRUE unit cost (filament+power+wear+5-15% failures+time); pet tags/gear reported $8-60, keychains $5-12

summary: Original 3D models, modelled by you (Blender is the free, open-source tool), sold as STL downloads. Research verdict (2026-11-23): anything a stranger can download free (flexi dragons, generic stands) has collapsed in price — original, hobby-specific, problem-solving and personalised models hold value. One modelling session can feed two listings: the file, and a physical print of your own design (allowed under the June 2025 original-design rule; bought/free files printed as-is are NOT).
